test: frame identity across IA original and IA derivative
detail: Frame index 462 decoded from the WebM matches frame 462 of the IA MP4 derivative (PSNR 32.5 dB, against 17.8-21.1 dB for frames 460, 461, 463, 464). Both sit at about 15.415 s.

native: Viewed source/raw/frame-000462.png at 480x360. EGGHEAD SOFTWARE lettering is legible on the glass, the door is open with a yellow Store Hours card, and boxed software is stacked in the window. A shopper is seen from behind through the door glass; no identifiable face. Burned-in timecode 10:46:14;06 at top right.
full_size: Viewed exports/editorial-frame.png at 1920x1080. 4:3 picture at 1440x1080 centred between 240 px black bars. No stretch, no crop, no added text. The sign is clearly readable. The image is soft and shows compression blocking, as expected from a 3x upscale of 480x360 video. The timecode box sits at about y=15-65, above the y=72 safe line; it is source content, not authored text.
proof_720: Viewed proofs/editorial-frame-720.png at 1280x720. The sign stays readable and the storefront reads immediately. Softness is less noticeable than at 1080p.
